question: Who among the following released a signature tune for ‘Vande Bharatam’ in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meenakshi Lekhi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The mark tune for** "Vande Bharatam" **created by Grammy Grant champ Ricky Kej and Oscar competitor Bickram Ghosh was delivered by Priest of State for Culture and Outside Undertakings.
 
• Vande Mataram was first distributed as a sonnet in** 1882** in Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay's Anandmath , written in Bengali and Sanskrit..
 
• **In 1896, **the melody was first sung freely at the Indian Public Congress' meeting, by Rabindranath Tagore himself.
 
• The initial two refrains of the melody were embraced as the Public Tune of India in** October 1937 **by the Congress Working Board of trustees preceding the finish of frontier rule in** August 1947.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pratima Bhoumik** is an Indian legislator who is presently filling in as Priest of State in the Service of Civil rights and Strengthening in Second Modi service.
 
• **Smriti Zubin Irani** is an Indian government official and a previous TV entertainer and maker.
 
• **Anupriya Pate**l is an Indian lawmaker from the territory of Uttar Pradesh having a place with the Apna Dal (Sonelal) party presently filling in as the Clergyman of State for Business and Industry of India since** 7 July 2021.**
